_doc: Robot Builder parts (systems/robot_builder.gd): pure cosmetics, worn by robot type at the Locker (systems/robot_design.gd). Each part is a found piece (data/cosmetics.json targets.crew, slot crew_<slot>): never bought, crafted or won from a counter; once found it fits every robot. Parts change no stats; only the Maker set (three Maker parts) keeps the small set_bonus perk. Five slots per robot; 'stock' (no entry) keeps the Mk tier's own look. mods (set_bonus only) are multipliers on generic stats: speed, load, work, quality, reach, scan. roles: which crews a tool fits (multibots take any tool). set: the part belongs to the Maker set. traits: robot personalities (flavour; mods unused).

salvage._doc: Working robots spot salvage now and then: chance per second = base * scan. A find pays Parts (mostly Rusty/Worn); 1 in fragment_one_in is a Maker Fragment.
